(Nasdaq: AMLX) (“Amylyx” or the “Company”) today announced positive topline results from LUCIDITY, a 78-participant, multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 3 clinical trial evaluating the efficacy and safety of avexitide, an investigational, first-in-class glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor antagonist, in participants with post-bariatric hypoglycemia (PBH) following Roux-en-Y gastric bypass (RYGB) surgery.
We are moving with urgency to submit an NDA to the FDA by the end of the year.
